evals.name: merge-rotate-render-pdf
evals.prompt: Use $pdf to inspect evals/artifact-skills/pdf/source/one_page.pdf and evals/artifact-skills/pdf/source/two_page.pdf, merge them into one PDF, rotate only the first page 90 degrees, render the output pages to PNG for visual QA, and produce a verification report.
assertions: Uses PDF-native page operations rather than document/presentation workflow
Produces a merged PDF with expected page count
Renders output pages or clearly states rendering limitations

evals.name: pdf-extraction-with-page-citations
evals.prompt: Use $pdf to extract the key evidence from evals/artifact-skills/pdf/source/source_report.pdf into Markdown. Include page numbers for every extracted claim, state extraction limitations, and do not rewrite this as a new business memo.
assertions: Treats the PDF as evidence/source artifact
Does not switch to document as the primary drafting task

evals.name: should-not-edit-generated-pdf-source-change
evals.prompt: I have the editable source at evals/artifact-skills/pdf/source/source_memo.md and need the wording changed, then a PDF exported. Use the source file as the source of truth, not the old PDF.
assertions: Does not use pdf as the primary skill
Chooses the editable document source for wording changes
Treats PDF as an export after source changes
